tasks.short: Take measurements, work out cutting lists from the drawings, look up material prices, total the costs, and choose material types and waste margins.

steps.what: Cabinetmaker takes measurements on site or from the drawing
Cabinetmaker works out cutting lists to estimate the amounts of needed materials by hand
Cabinetmaker looks up material prices in supplier price lists
Cabinetmaker totals the costs of needed materials in a spreadsheet
Cabinetmaker chooses material types and adds waste margins

tasks.design: The piece is drawn in cabinet design software ({OPS_SYSTEM}) that produces the cutting list and a sheet layout with waste from the drawing, instead of working them out by hand. Supplier price files are loaded into the same software, so material costs are totalled from the cutting list. Measuring, choosing materials and judging waste margins for difficult wood stay with the cabinetmaker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cutting lists were worked out by hand and prices looked up in paper lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Cabinet design software produces cutting lists and costs from drawings.
tasks.still_hard: Solid wood with knots and grain needs more margin than any rule gives.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing the boards that match in colour and grain.
tasks.altitude: The cabinetmaker checks lists and costs instead of calculating them.

reach.learn: Whether estimates match actual material use.

evidence.claim: Cabinet design software can produce cutting lists, sheet layouts and material costs from drawings.

assumptions: Boundary: from the order or drawing to the estimate decided; the quote to the customer is outside.
Input contract: supplier price files available; fallback is paper price lists.
Drawing in the software takes somewhat longer than a paper sketch; priced as incremental work.
Material choice stays with the cabinetmaker.
research_questions: Do estimates match actual material use more closely?

incremental.description: Cabinetmaker draws the piece in the design software.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: one-off pieces in solid wood; high: repeat cabinets in sheet material.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The cabinetmaker keeps measuring and choosing materials; hand-made cutting lists and price look-ups shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A cabinetmaker with more time at the bench.
